Site.name: Konstantin Konyushkin
Site.description: Software engineer and full-stack developer with a love for history and heraldry. Homepage and project collection.

HomePage.greeting: Hello. I build software by day and read chronicles by night.

about.title: About
about.text: Konstantin builds software the way a scribe kept a chronicle, one careful line at a time, and with a weakness for the marginalia. TypeScript fills his working hours, in the browser and on the server. History and heraldry fill the rest. This page is his armoury, and every piece in it was kept for a reason.

bio.title: Bio
bio.born: Born in Ulan-Ude (<ar>أولان أودي</ar>), the Russian Federation.
bio.university: Started studying information security at Moscow Power Engineering Institute (<ar>معهد موسكو للطاقة</ar>).
